data.name: Harv
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name 'Havvah', meaning 'God of War'. In the Old Testament, Har is mentioned as a god of the storm and battle, sometimes identified with the Canaanite god Baal. The name Harv is a modern variation of Har and carries the same meaning and spiritual significance.
